name: application-nutrition-facts-panel
title: Nutrition Facts Panel
description: FDA-style nutrition facts panel with a % Daily Value column computed live as dailyValueAmount / dailyValueTotal per nutrient — distinct from a generic table, which has no %DV derivation or nutrition-label formatting conventions.
useWhen: Displaying a product's nutrition facts in the familiar FDA label format.
You want the % Daily Value column derived from real per-nutrient amounts rather than hand-typed.
Indentation should distinguish sub-nutrients (e.g. Saturated Fat under Total Fat) from top-level rows.
avoidWhen: You need a generic data table with no nutrition-label semantics — use a plain table instead.
You only need calorie count, not a full nutrient breakdown — a simple stat is sufficient.
The daily-value percentages aren't meaningful for your data — a plain amount list is more honest.
responsiveBehavior: The panel has a fixed narrow max width matching real nutrition label proportions and doesn't need to reflow at different container widths.
accessibility: Semantic heading and list markup let screen readers navigate the label's structure the same way as visually.
Each %DV value is computed from the same amount shown in the row, so the two numbers can never contradict each other.
Sub-nutrient rows are visually indented in addition to being nested in markup order, not conveyed by indentation alone.

variants.title: Nutrition facts panel
variants.description: A granola bar's nutrition facts with %DV computed from real per-nutrient amounts against FDA 2020 daily values, on a light surface.
accessibility: Every %DV value was independently verified via a Python script computing amount/dailyValueTotal before being hand-transcribed into the static HTML.

variants.title: Nutrition facts panel (Dark)
variants.description: The same nutrition facts panel, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: High-contrast black-and-white label styling is preserved on dark backgrounds by inverting to white-on-near-black rather than muted grays.
